headline: South Africa Marks 525 Consecutive Days Without Scheduled Power Cuts
summary: State utility Eskom reached 525 consecutive days without scheduled rotational power outages, maintaining grid stability ahead of the year-end holiday period.
why: Eskom's operational recovery eliminates electricity load shedding, a critical headwind that severely curtailed South African industrial output and GDP growth.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Sustained grid stability lowers operational costs and enhances manufacturing capacity utilization.
